description:
A HDD/SSD utility software which supports parts of USB, Intel RAID and NVMe.


- Added support for retrieving detailed information in JMS59X RAID mode (IDENTIFY DEVICE command support).
- Added support for SATA disks behind a SAS HBA
  https://github.com/hiyohiyo/CrystalDiskInfo/pull/322
- Added language file (Hindi)
- Updated language files (Vietnamese, Russian)
